items.source_quote: June 11 The first episode of American Idol airs.

items.text: Kelly Clarkson's debut single "A Moment Like This" leapt from number 52 to number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in 2002.
items.question: Where were you living when Kelly Clarkson's "A Moment Like This" was on the radio, and who in your life knew all the words?
source_quote: The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart that ranks the best-performing singles of the United States.

Singer Kelly Clarkson's debut single "A Moment Like This" is noted for its 52-to-one leap in 2002, breaking the 38-year-old record set by The Beatles' "Can't Buy Me Love", which jumped from number 27 to one.

items.text: The Winter Olympics were held in Salt Lake City, Utah, from February 8 to 24, 2002.
items.question: Who did you watch the Salt Lake City Winter Olympics with, and which event do you remember best?
items.source_quote: February 8–24 – The Winter Olympics are held in Salt Lake City, Utah.
